build_GumbelVectorQuantizer: build a GumbelVectorQuantizer module with configurable groups, temperature decay, and vector quantization dimensions
run_forward_quantization: run forward pass through GumbelVectorQuantizer to quantize input tensors using gumbel softmax sampling
sample_codebook_vectors: sample random vectors from the quantizer codebook using sample_from_codebook with batch and count
review_codebook_indices: review the codebook indices and perplexity metrics computed by the GumbelVectorQuantizer forward pass
test_set_num_updates: test temperature anneulation by calling set_num_updates to decay the current temperature over training steps
